messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Still the same, Trent. Shop···· is paid and sitting at the warehouse, nothing shipped yet.

Your B30 with the free Power Kit ships November 7, 2026, and the tracking comes to this email the moment it leaves.

You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . Dates there move a little as stock shifts between warehouses.

Anything else you want me to check?
Do you know where the b30 will ship from ?

Your address is in Queensland, so it goes out from our US warehouse, which serves Australia and the rest of the world. The warehouse hasn't been locked in on the shipment yet, that happens when stock lands, but the region rule is what decides it.

It ships out with the plug and voltage matched to your address. Date is still November 7.
Sweet thanks. How is the magic miner 40t looking to please ?

Still on track, Trent. Shop····, the Magic Miner 40T, is at the warehouse and not shipped yet. It ships November 14, 2026, a week after the B30, and tracking comes to this email as soon as it leaves.

Same thing on origin: Queensland means it goes from our US warehouse.

You can watch that batch come in here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

No worries, Trent.

One thing I'm curious about: you told me last week the B30 and the 40T were the setup for now, then a third order went on the same day. What tipped you into adding another one?
I ordered the harlo labs loto is that what you see ?

That's the one, Shop····: the Harlo Loto early bird deposit, $20, paid on October 30. No ship date on it, it's a deposit that holds your spot rather than a unit going out.

So what pulled you in on the Loto, the early access spot or the hardware itself?
Looks and sounds very cool and fun. Something i can show my friend and let them have a play on

That's exactly the appeal of it, a miner your mates can actually have a go on.

Thanks for humouring the questions, Trent. Dates stand: B30 November 7, 40T November 14, both from the US warehouse.

Happy to have helped. If you were pleased with how we handled it, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

And if you're not in there yet, our Discord is the best spot for setup help and new drops: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
